newsitem.title: USA: Gold Capital gets $15.9 mln in financing.
newsitem.headline: Gold Capital gets $15.9 mln in financing.

text.p: Gold Capital Corp said Friday its pending merger partner, Globex Mining Enterprises Inc, successfully completed $15.9 million in equity financing through Bunting Warburg Inc.

Once their merger is completed, which is expected around August 30, Globex will use the money for development of Gold Capital Corp.'s Tonkin Springs, Nevada, gold mine, the company said in a news release.

"This equity funding, together with the signed commitment letter of $13 million in senior debt and $10 million in a secured hedging line previously announced by Globex, provides a solid financial base to place the Tonkin Springs mine into production and to explore the excellent property position," stated Bill Conrad, president of Gold Capital Corp, in a statement accompanying the release.
Globex will hold a 60-percent ownership interest in the Tonkin Springs mine, once the merger is complete. U.S. Gold Corp owns the remaining 40 percent.
